title: A Reiki master wrote a UK number two, and it's both AI and human
subtitle: Movin' To The Sun started as an AI demo by a Reiki master, then a DJ and a house legend finished it. The Grammys split it in two. Here is who did which bit, and why that's the question to ask at work.
